title: The Invisible Cost of Holding Cash
recommendedTitle: The Invisible Cost of Holding Cash
alternativeTitles: Why Safe Money Slowly Loses Value Over Time
How Inflation Quietly Erodes Your Purchasing Power
description:
Keeping cash in a bank account feels safe because the nominal balance never changes. However, when prices double, your cash buys half as much as it did a decade ago.

Understand how the real value of currency changes over time and how to preserve long-term purchasing power.
